title: ファンタスティックなお茶会

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! I received a lovely invitation to a special event today, and you're coming with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No time for questions! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Welcome, and thank you both for coming. It's a pleasure to have you here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find myself at one of the prestigious Mejiro family's tea parties. Being suddenly dragged into such an exquisite atmosphere is enough to make anyone nervous…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Dober! Thanks for inviting us today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all! Please enjoy yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I never would've thought you'd invite Pearl, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, she joined me for some partner running the other day, so this is my way of saying thanks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I heard from Dober that you often hold tea parties like this, so I asked her if I could attend one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I see! Well, the tea that Dober brews tastes great, so you're in for a treat! Go ahead and enjoy a cup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, this is just heavenly! What a fantastic cup of tea! And such rich flavor… Is this Assam?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm glad it suits your palate. And you're correct. Today's blend is an Assam milk tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In truth, Dober selected all the tea blends and accompanying desserts for today's gathering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Might I suggest you give the chocolate truffles a try? They're delightfully rich and milky.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! They really are excellent! And this buttery financier goes so well with the rich Assam tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So what were you up to last weekend, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, I hit up a driving range. I was hoping to increase my distance, but things didn't really pan out…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I bet you'd have better luck if you really put some oomph behind your swing and gave the ball a good whack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, you know how to golf, Pearl?! I want to increase my driving distance, so do you think you could give me some pointers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them step outside into the garden to practice golf swings. I'm a little puzzled, though, since I don't recall Seeking the Pearl ever mentioning being into golf…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've got my club face positioning down, but I just can't seem to increase the club head speed…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If you want to increase the speed, you just need to swing with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Strike it boldly with explosive strength, and ka-ching! You've hit a home run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I see. So the explosiveness of my downswing is the key, huh? And I'll need to build up my arm muscles to increase my swing strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you want to beef up and increase your explosive power, I recommend you do some antagonistic training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Take your arms, for example. You need to strengthen both your biceps and their antagonistic pair, your triceps, to get the most from your training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's more beneficial to train them as a set, like how ordering a combo meal is more cost effective than ordering a single burger! It just makes more sense!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yup! That's the most efficient way to train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Training your antagonistic muscles will improve the overall stability and flexibility of your main working muscles, so your explosive power will skyrocket!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Extraordinary! The muscular system holds so many possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You could say that again! Wow, I never imagined you'd understand the appeal of muscles so well, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I somehow doubt she's exactly on the same page as the others… but everyone seems to be enjoying the conversation just fine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And what about you, Trainer?! What do you think about the latent potential within biceps?!
choice_data_list: I-I guess it might be infinite?!
Train them enough, and you could even defeat a gorilla one day!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! That's exactly right! There are infinite possibilities out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All right, I'm going to push my biceps to their very limits!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No, Ryan, there are no limits! Let's push ourselves forever into the great unknown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right! Let's get right to it, then! We can start with dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's just what I was thinking! Let's get big and buff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I realize it, the tea party has turned into a bodybuilder's club. At least everyone seems to be having a great time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm just about to brush it off as a joke, but I don't get the chance before Seeking the Pearl jumps in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What an eccentric idea, Trainer! I expected no less from you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going train until I get strong enough to take down a gorilla! And once I do, I'm going to wrestle one for real!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, how's that for an interesting challenge? Let's head to the zoo and see if they'll agree to set up such a battle for us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-wait a minute, Pearl! That's too reckless of a proposal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The challenge Seeking the Pearl suggests is far too dangerous, so Mejiro Dober and I both desperately try to reel in her ambitions.
